data.name: Libra Apocrypha
data.detailed_description:
In the aftermath of the Reverie, there was only ash and blood.

Libra Apocrypha is a dark-fantasy deckbuilding RPG combining turn-based combat, roguelite progression, and a character-driven narrative set in a world torn apart by divine madness.

Play as the agent of a Mad God, forged to restore balance in a realm collapsing under conflict. The First Mortal rises to challenge the heavens, and your choices, in battle and beyond, will decide the fate of Eurva.

Collect followers and minions, equip weapons, armor and artifacts, and build your deck to shape your playstyle. Between duels, influence the fractured factions of the World of Eurva and take on quests that reveal the forgotten history of a broken world stitched together by madness.

  • Build your deck from weapons, armor, and relics that define your combat style.

  • Master the battlefield with tactical, turn-based card combat that rewards timing and synergy.

  • Influence factions and uncover ancient lore through quests that reveal the fractured history of the World of Eurva.

Will you serve your creator, or end her dream forever?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 3 3300X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580 (4 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
  • Additional Notes: Runs at 1080p / 60 FPS on Medium settings.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 3 3300X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 / AMD RX 6700 XT or higher
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
  • Additional Notes: Runs at 1080p / 60 FPS on Medium settings.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS Sequoia 15 or Later
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5 (quad-core)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 GPU or AMD Radeon Pro 560X (4 GB VRAM)
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated audio device
  • Additional Notes: Native Apple Silicon build planned; Intel versions may experience reduced performance.
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 12 Monterey or later
  • Processor: Apple M2 or Intel Core i7 (6-core)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M2 GPU or AMD Radeon Pro 5700 XT
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated audio device
  • Additional Notes: Native Apple Silicon build planned; Intel versions may experience reduced performance.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: SteamOS 3.0 / Ubuntu 22.04 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 3 3300X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580 (Mesa drivers recommended)
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated audio device
  • Additional Notes: Verified working on Steam Deck with medium settings; stable 40–60 FPS expected.

  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 / AMD RX 6700 XT
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
